diff_checks.scope: 39 task files before this QA record; only new model-channel archive/modules, prospective README and package scripts; no historical/frozen files changed

independent_archive_checks.scan_limitation: Known fixture-only credential form and retained base64 fields, not proof against arbitrary encoded real secrets; capability originals are intentionally not archived

boundary_review: Immutable exact request and copied identity; fixed route and scoped capability; atomic one-dispatch budget remains consumed after failures or duplicate clients
HTTP401/429/503, redirects, SSE disconnection and drip deadlines do not retry, refresh or reconnect at this relay boundary
Total inbound/response time and byte/connection limits; pre-dispatch close records null request observation/zero attempts; active close preserves one failed partial
Parent-only dummy auth and actual exact-port Seatbelt probe; direct fake-upstream port refused and clean child environment retained
Fixed media types and known literal/Base64/hex/common ASCII Unicode redaction applied before response/evidence parsing and client delivery
Intent/configured route/observed request/upstream report distinct; provider remains null and request-level effort is not internal/dynamic effort attestation
Current source hashes and sanitized-byte hashes checked offline; archived sources are data only and never executed
Known dummy-service provenance is explicit; locality alone does not prove a fake service

post_QA_process_check.method: One read-only ps snapshot, exact fixed client source plus canonical Node executable; no signals sent
post_QA_process_check.limitation: No inference about arbitrary host services or processes outside the task probe

limitations: Fake loopback upstream only; no real provider or Codex turn
Known literal dummy credential redaction is not arbitrary real-provider secret nonleakage proof
Buffered bounded relay, not faithful real-time streaming
Whole-process endpoint grant does not separate Codex model client from agent tools
Upstream reasoning.effort is request-level report, not actual internal/dynamic effort
Reported model/endpoint do not authenticate executed model/provider; provider remains unobserved
Effective CLI config, capability delivery, HTTPS/OAuth/refresh, provider-internal retries and full executor integration unverified
Actual fixed Node channel probe is not complete guardian-backed executor integration
Darwin Seatbelt probe ran here with no skipped tests; other platforms explicitly skip OS probe and isolation remains unverified
Secure raw provider-wire custody and arbitrary secret transformations remain unverified
Actual Codex-to-local-stub wiring could be separately tested offline later; not attempted in this revision
